weight_selection: Secondary analysis only: maximize equal-drug mean MRR on Davis-disjoint TRAIN drugs; average cells within each drug; ties select smaller DTA weight. No validation tuning.
rank_combination: Average-tie percentile ranks within the same cell-specific target library; higher is better; (1-w)*response_rank+w*DTA_rank
tie_evaluation: Expected Hit@K, Recall@5 and reciprocal rank under uniform random ordering within exact-score ties
observed: Pearson of measured drug signature and each genetic TRAINING-library signature on all 978 genes
observed_centered: Subtract chemical training mean from drug response (exclude own parent for train); subtract genetic-library mean from each genetic response; exploratory sensitivity only
g2cp_predicted: Mean response vector across the three frozen local G2CP training seeds; compare with each genetic library signature. Report separately from measured-response input.
frequency_baseline: Annotated target frequency across distinct strict training drug parents; exclude the query training parent; unannotated targets remain unknown
shuffle_rule: Permute gate scores across target identities independently within drug/cell; combine equally with observed or predicted response ranks. Descriptive negative control, not a confirmatory permutation test.
coverage: All frozen library targets are candidates. Only known annotated positives are scored; pairs without a positive in the library are reported as unavailable, not negative.
development_boundary: Exploration after previous experiments. Train/validation only; no new test scoring, new G2CP training or fresh external confirmation. Existing source annotations are incomplete, not independently biochemically revalidated.
